question.problem: Find the common ratio of the geometric sequence whose fourth term is $135$ and whose seventh term is $5.$
question.worked_solution:
To find the common ratio $r$ of a geometric sequence given two terms ${a}_{m}$ and ${a}_{n},$ we use the formula 

$$
{r}^{n-m}=\frac{{a}_{n}}{{a}_{m}}.
$$

In this case, we're given ${a}_{7}=5$ and ${a}_{4}=135.$ Substituting $n=7$ and $m=4$ into the formula, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{r}^{7-4} & =\frac{{a}_{7}}{{a}_{4}} \\ {r}^{3} & =\frac{5}{135} \\ {r}^{3} & =\frac{1}{27}.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, by solving the equation for $r,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{r}^{3} & =\frac{1}{27} \\ {r}^{3} & ={(\frac{1}{3})}^{3} \\ r & =\frac{1}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$
